findings.evidenceJa: スローボールのように
findings.governingReading: like a slowball
findings.explanation: The explicit slowball image describing Rin’s deliberately reduced speed becomes a different baseball pitch whose defining feature is deception rather than mere slowness.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が体を起こす
findings.governingReading: Rin raises herself up
findings.explanation: Rin’s movement from concealment becomes a jump, prematurely making her reaction larger and less controlled.

findings.highlight: no time to be screwing up the “strengthening” magic
findings.evidenceJa: “強化”に戸惑っている余裕などない
findings.governingReading: There is no time to hesitate over Strengthening
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of time for uncertainty becomes an assertion that he is performing the technique incorrectly.

findings.evidenceJa: 純粋な転移
findings.governingReading: pure teleportation
findings.explanation: The technical qualifier “pure,” distinguishing the phenomenon’s nature, becomes the result-oriented “complete.”

findings.evidenceJa: 魔法とされる
findings.governingReading: is classified as Magic
findings.explanation: The setting’s categorical distinction between true Magic and magecraft is replaced by generic sorcery.

findings.highlight: Caster has easily performed such a thing to appear
findings.evidenceJa: 神秘を事も無げに体現し、黒い魔女は現れていた
findings.governingReading: Effortlessly embodying that Mystery, the black witch appeared
findings.explanation: The Mystery terminology, Caster’s written epithet “black witch,” and the scene’s manifestation image are collapsed into generic performance.

findings.evidenceJa: そう楽しげに言って
findings.governingReading: Caster says it with evident delight
findings.explanation: Caster’s cultivated enjoyment of the threat disappears, and the English turns the narration into a dangling “since” fragment.

findings.evidenceJa: 木刀を下げたまま
findings.governingReading: keeping my wooden sword lowered
findings.explanation: The nonthreatening posture essential to Shirou stepping out to question Kuzuki disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t even feel his desire to win the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争を戦い抜こう、という意思さえ感じない
findings.governingReading: I cannot sense even an intention to fight the Holy Grail War through
findings.explanation: Absence of fighting commitment becomes absence of a desire for victory, which does not support Shirou’s inference in the same way.

findings.evidenceJa: 教壇と変わらぬ声
findings.governingReading: in the same voice he uses at the lectern
findings.explanation: The unnerving continuity between Kuzuki’s classroom voice and intervention in a lethal confrontation becomes generic habitual behavior.

findings.evidenceJa: 紫紺のローブ
findings.governingReading: the dark-purple robe
findings.explanation: The concrete color and the metonymic image of the robe itself issuing the warning disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: マトモな人間
findings.governingReading: a decent, sane person
findings.explanation: Shirou’s premise that Kuzuki is a morally normal person becomes the narrower trait of truthfulness.

findings.evidenceJa: 今までも、そしてこれからも犠牲者は増え続ける
findings.governingReading: The victims have continued to increase until now, and will continue increasing from here
findings.explanation: The ongoing past accumulation and explicit future continuity collapse into a generic forecast.

findings.evidenceJa: 通常、善良な人間
findings.governingReading: Ordinarily, a good person
findings.explanation: The ethical predicate that grounds Shirou’s accusation becomes statistical or psychological normality.

findings.highlight: straight-forward like when he is teaching
findings.evidenceJa: 教壇に立つ姿のように潔癖だった
findings.governingReading: as uncompromisingly fastidious as he was at the lectern
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s severe moral and personal cleanliness becomes communicative directness, weakening the disturbing continuity in his character.

findings.evidenceJa: 平然と
findings.governingReading: without the slightest disturbance
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s emotional composure while questioning mass harm becomes mere clarity of expression.

findings.highlight: You should have drained all of their energy
findings.evidenceJa: 一息で根こそぎ奪った方がよい
findings.governingReading: You would have done better to take everything, root and branch, in a single breath
findings.explanation: The speed, totality, and ruthless efficiency of Kuzuki’s proposed alternative are reduced to quantity alone.

findings.evidenceJa: 教壇に立つ姿のまま
findings.governingReading: still exactly as he stands before his class
findings.explanation: The reiterated classroom posture that makes Kuzuki’s murderous judgment uncanny disappears.

findings.highlight: I do not care about anyone
findings.evidenceJa: 全ての人間は無関係だが
findings.governingReading: All people are equally unrelated to me
findings.explanation: Kuzuki states an absence of relational involvement; the English converts it into an emotional attitude of not caring.

findings.highlight: I do not care about the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 私は聖杯戦争など知らん
findings.governingReading: I know nothing of this Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s professed ignorance—the point of the preceding inquiry—is changed into informed apathy.

findings.highlight: If Caster and you two are going to kill each other
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターが殺し、おまえたちが殺し合う
findings.governingReading: if Caster kills and you people kill one another
findings.explanation: Caster’s independent killing and the Masters’ mutual slaughter become a fight between Caster and only Shirou and Rin.

findings.highlight: I only kill those that are attacking me
findings.evidenceJa: 私を阻むモノを殺すだけ
findings.governingReading: I merely kill whatever obstructs me
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s much broader willingness to kill any impediment is narrowed into apparent self-defense.

findings.evidenceJa: とんだ狸同士
findings.governingReading: what a pair of consummate tanuki
findings.explanation: Rin’s accusation that Caster and Kuzuki are matched dissemblers becomes an unnatural comment about physically or figuratively “big foxes.”

findings.evidenceJa: 白銀の鎧で武装したセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber, already arrayed in silver armor
findings.explanation: The visual transformation into Saber’s silver armor disappears at the instant she launches her charge.

findings.highlight: She uses five verses for her spell
findings.evidenceJa: 詰めるは五間
findings.governingReading: The distance to close is five ken
findings.explanation: A unit of distance—about ten meters, restated immediately afterward—is catastrophically misread as five units of spell recitation.

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターは雷鳴だろう
findings.governingReading: Caster would be a thunderclap
findings.explanation: The auditory thunder image answering Saber’s gust becomes ungrammatical lightning.

findings.highlight: a knight that can defend against my magic
findings.evidenceJa: 私の魔術を防ぎきる騎士
findings.governingReading: a knight capable of completely warding off my magecraft
findings.explanation: Caster’s technical claim about her magecraft becomes generic magic and loses the completeness of Saber’s resistance.

findings.highlight: The one she has to slash
findings.evidenceJa: その剣で両断すべき相手
findings.governingReading: the opponent she must bisect with that sword
findings.explanation: The intended decisive two-way severing is weakened to an unspecified slash.

findings.highlight: Saber stops after slashing her sword
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を振るった姿勢のまま止まっている
findings.governingReading: Saber remains frozen in the posture of having swung her sword
findings.explanation: mirror moon says she slashes the sword itself and loses the sustained posture that prepares the reversal.
